subject.title: fix: Windows /restart falls back to in-process restart without changing PID

question: Should env-less Windows gateways probe the installed OpenClaw Scheduled Task for `/restart`, or should they continue to use only the current in-process fallback unless supervisor markers are present?
rationale: The desired behavior touches compatibility-sensitive restart supervision: current main intentionally avoids unmanaged Windows detached respawn, while the candidate fix adds a new Scheduled Task discovery path.

options.title: Review schtasks probing
options.body: Proceed with the focused PR that detects a real Scheduled Task while keeping unmanaged detached respawn disabled.

options.title: Keep marker-only detection
options.body: Reject the new discovery path and document that raw Windows gateway processes without service markers use in-process restart only.

recommendation.title: Review schtasks probing
recommendation.body: Proceed with the focused PR that detects a real Scheduled Task while keeping unmanaged detached respawn disabled.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Windows Scheduled Task restart path that this decision would extend.
